verdict.rationale: Supabase's MCP server lets an AI agent run arbitrary SQL against the Postgres database (supabase-docs-1, supabase-probe-rt-2), and Postgres itself naturally supports bulk UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT across many rows, plus Queues and Cron for batch/background job processing (supabase-docs-9, supabase-docs-10). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-operations API, batch endpoint, or agent-specific guidance for operating across many items at once — the capability is inferred from generic SQL access rather than a first-class documented feature. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API or agent-skill documentation calling out multi-item operations, and any hands-on evidence of an agent actually performing large bulk operations via MCP.
